title.english: Su'ad (4) bint Salama ibn Zuhayr ibn Tha'laba ibn 'Ubayd ibn 'Adi ibn Ghanm ibn (5) Ka'b ibn Salama al-Ansariyya.

segments.arabic:
ذكرها ابن سعد في المبايعات، وقال: هي التي سألت النبيّ ﷺ أن يبايعها لما في بطنها، وكانت حاملا،
فقال لها النبي ﷺ: «أنت حرّة من الحرائر» .
قال: وأمها أم قيس بنت حرام بن لوذان، وتزوجها حسنة بن صخر بن أمية بن خنساء بن عبيد.
segments.english:
Ibn Sa'd mentioned her among the women who pledged allegiance and said: She was the one who asked the Prophet—may Allah bless him and grant him peace—to accept her pledge on behalf of what was in her womb, and she was pregnant. The Prophet—may Allah bless him and grant him peace—said to her: “You are a freeborn woman among freeborn women.”

He said: Her mother was Umm Qays bint Haram ibn Lawdhan, and Hasana ibn Sakhr ibn Umayya ibn Khansa ibn Ubayd married her.

names.arabic: أم قيس بنت حرام بن لوذان
names.english: Umm Qays bint Haram ibn Lawdhan

unresolved.explanation: The consonantal text does not establish the vowels of حسنة, and the supplied Urdu and collateral evidence does not resolve them. “Hasana” is retained provisionally.
